sections.title: Live countdown to a deadline
sections.what: Shows the time left until a target date and time, updating every second. Turns red and pulses when fewer than two days remain. Shows Passed or Due Today once the time has gone.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps deadlines visible and urgent as they approach.
sections.watch_out: If the date is empty or invalid, the countdown can show NaN values, and the code does not check for this.
